title: Twelve Monkeys Hakuna Shorfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Hakuna by Twelve Monkeys delivers a refreshing balance of crisp Apple and tart Cranberry, creating a layered fruit blend that is both sweet and slightly sharp. The juicy Apple notes provide a smooth and refreshing inhale, while the bold Cranberry adds a tart complexity that lingers on the exhale for a well-rounded and satisfying vape. Designed with a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio, Hakuna is perfect for Sub-Ohm vape kits and high-powered DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, ensuring dense vapour production and full-bodied flavour. Supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, this e-liquid allows vapers to customise their nicotine strength to suit their preference. Twelve Monkeys is an award-winning Canadian e-liquid brand known for its innovative fruit blends, offering premium-quality ingredients and expertly crafted flavours for an exceptional vaping experience.
